name: A Broken Arm, a Lifelong Calling: Mary Wairimu's Nursing Journey

content.title: A Broken Arm, a Lifelong Calling: Mary Wairimu's Nursing Journey
content.summary: Meet Mary, inspired by nurse's care, decided to study nursing at AKU SONAM

content.text: For Mary Wairimu, affectionately known by her family and friends as 'Nimo', a simple hospital stay ignited a passion to study nursing. After fracturing her arm, Nimo encountered a compassionate nurse whose kindness and dedication inspired her to dedicate her academic career to healthcare.

Now a first-year nursing student at the Aga Khan University in Nairobi, Mary recounts the pivotal moment that shaped her path: "I vividly remember the nurse who cared for me. Her intelligence, empathy, and the way she made me feel safe, despite the pain, were truly remarkable. In that moment, I realized she wasn't just doing her job; she was making a tangible difference in my life." Mary shared. "I knew then that I wanted to be just like her-a source of comfort and strength for others in their most vulnerable moments."

Being admitted to the hospital was a turning point. Mary watched the nurse with admiration as she interacted with patients, realizing she was more than just a caregiver; she was a role model. The day the nurse placed a stethoscope around Mary's neck, she felt a glimpse of what could be. That day, she knew she wanted to touch lives the way the nurse had touched hers.

Mary's goals are ambitious, but so is her determination. She aspires to become a Clinical Nurse Specialist, excelling in various areas of nursing. She envisions herself stepping into leadership roles, such as a nurse manager, and conducting research that can improve patient care. Her mission is to provide compassionate care and be an innovator, finding solutions to everyday challenges in healthcare. "My passion for helping people, combined with a deep interest in medicine and science, solidified my choice to pursue nursing. I wanted to find a meaningful career that allowed me to make a positive impact on the world." Mary added. She wants to be remembered as a nurse who not only cared deeply but also helped drive meaningful change.

Choosing Aga Khan University felt like the right step toward living her dreams. Its reputation for academic excellence and professionalism is unmatched. As an international institution, it offers global opportunities that align with Mary's aspirations. The innovation and advanced technology in nursing science were huge draws for her, as was the experienced faculty who provide invaluable mentorship. To Mary, AKU is more than just an education; it's a gateway to becoming the best version of herself as a nurse.

Of course, Mary knows becoming a nurse won't be easy. She understands the emotional challenges and the balancing act between academics and personal responsibilities. However, she is eager to rise to the occasion and make a difference in the world.
